## Mathematical Physics {#mathematical-physics}

::: {.publication-card data-field="mp"}
<div class="badge-row"><span class="badge mp">Mathematical Physics</span><span class="badge published">Journal Article</span></div>

### Toroidal Quantum Gravity: I. Foundations

<div class="pub-meta">Alejandro Ascárate · <em>Classical and Quantum Gravity</em> 43, 145014 · 2026</div>

<div class="pub-summary">A background-independent quantum-spacetime framework based on noncommutative tori with spectral data, discrete causal structure, local activation dynamics, Markovian branching, and covariant gravitational variables.</div>

<div class="pub-links"><a href="https://doi.org/10.1088/1361-6382/ae85a6">Journal</a></div>
:::

::: {.publication-card data-field="mp"}
<div class="badge-row"><span class="badge mp">Mathematical Physics</span><span class="badge published">Journal Article</span></div>

### The Spacetime Picture in Quantum Gravity

<div class="pub-meta">Alejandro Ascárate · <em>Classical and Quantum Gravity</em> 38, 165010 · 2021</div>

<div class="pub-summary">A relational and noncommutative-geometric construction of quantum-spacetime elements, including a spectral interpretation of elementary areas and distances.</div>

<div class="pub-links"><a href="https://doi.org/10.1088/1361-6382/abcbde">Journal</a><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2012.03994">arXiv</a></div>
:::

::: {.publication-card data-field="mp"}
<div class="badge-row"><span class="badge mp">Mathematical Physics</span><span class="badge preprint">Preprint</span></div>

### Spacetime Relationalism in GR and QG

<div class="pub-meta">Alejandro Ascárate · arXiv:2109.03297 · 2021</div>

<div class="pub-summary">A formulation of spacetime relationalism grounded in the gravitational field and its phase-space description, intended as conceptual background for the quantum-spacetime programme.</div>

<div class="pub-links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.03297">arXiv</a></div>
:::

::: {.publication-card data-field="mp"}
<div class="badge-row"><span class="badge mp">Mathematical Physics</span><span class="badge preprint">Preprint</span></div>

### The Ontology and Semantics of Quantum Theory for Quantum Gravity

<div class="pub-meta">Alejandro Ascárate · arXiv:2109.10214 · 2021</div>

<div class="pub-summary">An analysis of the factual interpretation of quantum theory and its applicability to quantum gravity, based on a realist ontology and the lattice-probabilistic formalism.</div>

<div class="pub-links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.10214">arXiv</a></div>
:::

### Improving the Generation of VAEs with High Dimensional Latent Spaces by the Use of Hyperspherical Coordinates

<div class="pub-meta">Alejandro Ascarate, Léo Lebrat, Rodrigo Santa Cruz, Clinton Fookes, Olivier Salvado · IJCNN · 2025</div>

<div class="pub-summary">A hyperspherical-coordinate parameterisation that compresses latent vectors toward a controlled region of the sphere, reducing sparsity and improving generation in high-dimensional VAEs.</div>

<div class="pub-links"><a href="https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/document/11227651">IEEE</a><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.15900">arXiv</a></div>
:::

<div class="pub-meta">Alejandro Ascarate, Léo Lebrat, Rodrigo Santa Cruz, Clinton Fookes, Olivier Salvado · ICML Workshop on Hypothesis Testing · 2026</div>

<div class="pub-summary">A diagnosis of class-split anomaly-detection benchmarks in regimes where representation-space overlap produces AUROC collapse, inversion, and class-dependent score direction.</div>

<div class="pub-links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02601">arXiv</a><a href="https://openreview.net/group?id=ICML.cc%2F2026%2FWorkshop%2FHypothesis_Testing">Workshop</a></div>
